summary: The test is syntactically correct and uses Playwright APIs properly; however, the test title does not preserve the testCaseId TC-001. The selector used is targeted but could be improved by avoiding reliance on a numeric id which may be brittle. The assertion checks only for a generic URL pattern which is too weak to ensure the correct product detail page is displayed. There are no asynchronous assertion issues or compilation problems.

issues.description: The test title 'Verify Product Detail Page is Displayed' does not include the testCaseId 'TC-001' to trace back to the manual test case.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to preserve traceability.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is a hard-coded numeric ID that may be brittle if the data changes or more products are added.
issues.recommendation: Use more stable and descriptive selectors or parameterize the product ID for reusability.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex /product/ which does not confirm that the correct product detail page is displayed.
issues.recommendation: Strengthen the assertion by verifying specific URL path segments or checking presence of product-specific elements on the page.

recommendations: Include testCaseId in test titles to improve traceability.
Enhance selector robustness by avoiding hard-coded numeric IDs when possible.
Improve assertion criteria to ensure the correct product detail page is loaded, not just any product page.
